$comment: Available stack profiles. Order determines the setup menu. 'servers' keys must exist in config/inventory.json. 'system' marks GUI vs headless target.

profiles.name: Dev Workspace
profiles.description: Full desktop development workstation: orchestration, files, project memory, terminal, research, browser and design.

profiles.name: Headless Server
profiles.description: Client-oriented core for server OS / CI boxes: orchestration, files, memory, terminal and research. No GUI or device servers.

profiles.name: Research Terminal
profiles.description: Dedicated research node: research platform plus orchestration and file access.

profiles.name: Web Dev + Browser Automation
profiles.description: Browser automation and web operations with file, memory and orchestration support.

profiles.name: Android Testing Rig
profiles.description: Device testing and automation via scrcpy plus file and orchestration support.

profiles.name: 3D / Blender Station
profiles.description: Blender-based 3D modeling with file and orchestration support.

profiles.name: All (full inventory)
profiles.description: Install every server in the inventory.
